title: Turnus
summary: Raleigh names Turnus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Turnus, the sonne of Venilia, to whom Latinus promised Lauinia, slaine in the warre that followed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. III, sig. 347b
